BoundAttributes.Name: Validation
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudBaseButton.ButtonType">
            <summary>
            The type of button.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            Defaults to <c>Button</c>. Other values are <c>Submit</c> to submit a form, and <c>Reset</c> to clear a form.
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: Href
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudBaseButton.Href">
            <summary>
            The URL to navigate to when the button is clicked.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            Defaults to <c>null</c>. When clicked, the browser will navigate to this URL.  Use the <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudBaseButton.Target" /> property to target a specific tab.
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: Target
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudBaseButton.Target">
            <summary>
            The browser tab/window opened when a click occurs and <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudBaseButton.Href" /> is set.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            Defaults to <c>null</c>. This property allows navigation to open a new tab/window or to reuse a specific tab.  Possible values are <c>_blank</c>, <c>_self</c>, <c>_parent</c>, <c>_top</c>, <c>noopener</c>, or the name of an <c>iframe</c> element.
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: Rel
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudBaseButton.Rel">

            </summary>
            <remarks>
            This property is typically used by web crawlers to get more information about a link.  Common values can be found here: <see href="https://www.w3schools.com/tags/att_a_rel.asp" />

        </member>

            <summary>

            <para>

BoundAttributes.Name: Validation
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.

            For save and cancel notifications, use <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.CommittedItemChanges" />, <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.CommittedItemChanged" />,
            or <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.CanceledEditingItem" />.
            </remarks>

BoundAttributes.Name: CanceledEditingItem
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.CanceledEditingItem">
            <summary>
            Occurs when editing of an item has been canceled.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            This event is raised instead of <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.CommittedItemChanges" /> and <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.CommittedItemChanged" />
            when the edit operation is canceled.
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: CommittedItemChanges
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.CommittedItemChanges">
            <summary>
            Invoked when the user saves changes to an item, allowing validation, persistence, or other pre-commit work.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            In <see cref="F:MudBlazor.DataGridEditMode.Form" />, this callback receives the edited copy before values are applied to
            the source item. Return <see cref="F:MudBlazor.DataGridEditFormAction.Close" /> to continue or
            <see cref="F:MudBlazor.DataGridEditFormAction.KeepOpen" /> to leave the form open for corrections.
            Use <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.CommittedItemChanged" /> to react after the source item has been updated.
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: CommittedItemChanged
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.CommittedItemChanged">
            <summary>
            Occurs after committed changes have been applied to the underlying item.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            Use this callback for post-commit logic. In <see cref="F:MudBlazor.DataGridEditMode.Form" />, it runs after
            <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.CommittedItemChanges" /> completes and after values are copied to the source item.
            In <see cref="F:MudBlazor.DataGridEditMode.Cell" />, it runs after <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.CommittedItemChanges" /> completes,
            with the already-updated item.
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: ServerData
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.ServerData">
            <summary>
            The function which gets data for this grid.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            The function accepts a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.GridState`1" /> with current sorting, filtering, and pagination parameters.  Then, return a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.GridData`1" /> with a page of values, and the total (unpaginated) items set in <see cref="P:MudBlazor.GridData`1.TotalItems" />.  When set, the <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.Items" /> property cannot be set.
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: VirtualizeServerData
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.VirtualizeServerData">
            <summary>
            The function which gets data for this grid.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            The function accepts a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.GridStateVirtualize`1" /> with current sorting, filtering, and pagination parameters.
            Then, return a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.GridData`1" /> with a list of values, and the total (unpaginated) items count in <see cref="P:MudBlazor.GridData`1.TotalItems" />.
            This property is used when you need to display a list without a paginator,
            but with loading data from the server as the scroll position changes.
            </remarks>
        </member>

            <remarks>
            Use this event to react when editing starts. For form field changes, use <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.FormFieldChanged" />.
            For save and cancel notifications, use <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.CommittedItemChanges" />, <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.CommittedItemChanged" />,
            or <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.CanceledEditingItem" />.

BoundAttributes.Name: CommittedItemChanges
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.CommittedItemChanges">
            <summary>
            Invoked when the user saves changes to an item, allowing validation, persistence, or other pre-commit work.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            In <see cref="F:MudBlazor.DataGridEditMode.Form" />, this callback receives the edited copy before values are applied to
            the source item. Return <see cref="F:MudBlazor.DataGridEditFormAction.Close" /> to continue or
            <see cref="F:MudBlazor.DataGridEditFormAction.KeepOpen" /> to leave the form open for corrections.
            Use <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.CommittedItemChanged" /> to react after the source item has been updated.
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: CommittedItemChanged
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.CommittedItemChanged">
            <summary>
            Occurs after committed changes have been applied to the underlying item.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            Use this callback for post-commit logic. In <see cref="F:MudBlazor.DataGridEditMode.Form" />, it runs after
            <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.CommittedItemChanges" /> completes and after values are copied to the source item.
            In <see cref="F:MudBlazor.DataGridEditMode.Cell" />, it runs after <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudDataGrid`1.CommittedItemChanges" /> completes,
            with the already-updated item.
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: EditTemplate
BoundAttributes.Documentation: The template for editing values in this cell. When is , the built-in Save button automatically invokes — no extra handling is required. When is , standard columns commit their value automatically on change. Custom controls inside an do not trigger automatically. Track changes directly in a value-changed handler instead: <EditTemplate> <MudDatePicker Date="@context.Item.Date" DateChanged="@(d => { context.Item.Date = d; TrackChange(context.Item); })" /> </EditTemplate>

BoundAttributes.Name: Validation
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: Validation
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.

            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: Validation
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: Breakpoint
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudDrawer.Breakpoint">
            <summary>
            The browser width at which responsive drawers are hidden.
            </summary>
            <remarks> 
            Defaults to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Md" />.  Supported breakpoints are: 
            <list type="bullet"> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Xs" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Sm" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Md" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Lg" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Xl" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Xxl" /></description></item> 
            </list> 
            Other breakpoint combinations are aliased as follows: 
            <list type="bullet"> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.SmAndDown" />: Aliases to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Sm" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.MdAndDown" />: Aliases to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Md" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.LgAndDown" />: Aliases to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Lg" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.XlAndDown" />: Aliases to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Xl" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.SmAndUp" />: Aliases to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Sm" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.MdAndUp" />: Aliases to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Md" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.LgAndUp" />: Aliases to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Lg" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.XlAndUp" />: Aliases to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Xl" /></description></item> 
            </list> 
            <para>
            Setting the value to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.None" /> will always close the drawer, while <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Always" /> will always keep it open.
            </para>
            <para>
            Applies when <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudDrawer.Variant" /> is set to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.DrawerVariant.Responsive" /> or <see cref="F:MudBlazor.DrawerVariant.Mini" />.
            </para>
            </remarks> 
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: OverlayAutoClose
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudDrawer.OverlayAutoClose">
            <summary>
            Automatically closes the drawer when clicking on the overlay.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            If the <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudDrawer.Variant" /> is set to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.DrawerVariant.Temporary" />, an overlay will be displayed. 
            When this property is <c>true</c>, clicking on the overlay will close it automatically. 
            When this property is <c>false</c>, the overlay will not close automatically.
            Defaults to <c>true</c>.
            </remarks>
        </member>

            </summary>
            <remarks>

        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: Breakpoint
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudDrawer.Breakpoint">
            <summary>
            The browser width at which responsive drawers are hidden.
            </summary>
            <remarks> 
            Defaults to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Md" />.  Supported breakpoints are: 
            <list type="bullet"> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Xs" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Sm" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Md" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Lg" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Xl" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Xxl" /></description></item> 
            </list> 
            Other breakpoint combinations are aliased as follows: 
            <list type="bullet"> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.SmAndDown" />: Aliases to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Sm" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.MdAndDown" />: Aliases to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Md" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.LgAndDown" />: Aliases to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Lg" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.XlAndDown" />: Aliases to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Xl" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.SmAndUp" />: Aliases to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Sm" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.MdAndUp" />: Aliases to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Md" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.LgAndUp" />: Aliases to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Lg" /></description></item> 
            <item><description><see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.XlAndUp" />: Aliases to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Xl" /></description></item> 
            </list> 
            <para>
            Setting the value to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.None" /> will always close the drawer, while <see cref="F:MudBlazor.Breakpoint.Always" /> will always keep it open.
            </para>
            <para>
            Applies when <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudDrawer.Variant" /> is set to <see cref="F:MudBlazor.DrawerVariant.Responsive" /> or <see cref="F:MudBlazor.DrawerVariant.Mini" />.
            </para>
            </remarks> 
        </member>

TagHelpers.Name: MudBlazor.MudDragHandle<T>
TagHelpers.Documentation: A drag handle that restricts drag-and-drop initiation to a specific child element inside a . The type of item being dragged. Place this component anywhere inside a . Once registered, the parent item's full-element draggable behavior is suppressed so that only interactions with the handle element start a drag-and-drop transaction. Example — make only the card header draggable: <MudDropZone T="MyItem" ...> <ItemRenderer> <MudCard> <MudCardHeader> <MudDragHandle T="MyItem"> <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.DragIndicator" /> </MudDragHandle> <MudText>@context.Title</MudText> </MudCardHeader> <MudCardContent>...</MudCardContent> </MudCard> </ItemRenderer> </MudDropZone>

<member name="T:MudBlazor.MudExitPrompt">
            <summary>
            Shows a confirmation dialog when the user tries to navigate away.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            Due to browser restrictions the native browser exit prompt has to be used on browser navigation.
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: Title
BoundAttributes.Documentation: The title shown in the confirmation dialog. Defaults to the localized version of "Confirm navigation".

BoundAttributes.Name: Text
BoundAttributes.Documentation: The message shown in the confirmation dialog. Defaults to the localized version of "Leave site? Changes you made may not be saved.".

BoundAttributes.Name: Disabled
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudExitPrompt.Disabled">
            <summary>
            Disables exit prompt protection.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When set to <c>true</c>, navigation proceeds without confirmation and JS unload protection is removed.
            Defaults to <c>false</c>.
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: UseNativePrompt
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudExitPrompt.UseNativePrompt">
            <summary>
            Uses the browser's native confirmation prompt for in-app navigation.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When <c>false</c>, navigation inside the app uses a MudBlazor message box with <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudExitPrompt.Title" /> and <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudExitPrompt.Text" />.
            When <c>true</c>, in-app navigation uses the browser <c>confirm</c> dialog and <see cref="P:MudBlazor.MudExitPrompt.Title" /> is ignored.
            Tab close, refresh, and direct URL navigation always use the browser's native unload prompt.
            Defaults to <c>false</c>.
            </remarks>
        </member>

            </para>

            </para>

BoundAttributes.Name: Validation
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: Validation
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudForm.Validation">
            <summary>
            The default function or attribute used to validate form components which cannot validate themselves.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            Supported values are:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.

            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: Validation
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: Validation
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

            <summary>

            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: Validation
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: BoundaryCount
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
The number of pages shown before and after the ellipsis. Defaults to 1.
A value of 1 would show one-page number at the edge: < 1 ... 4 5 6 ... 9 >
A value of 2 would show two-page numbers at the edge: < 1 2 ... 4 5 6 ... 8 9 >

BoundAttributes.Name: MiddleCount
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
The number of pages shown between the ellipsis. Defaults to 1.
A value of 1 would show one-page number in the middle: < 1 ... 5 ... 9 >
A value of 3 would show three-page numbers in the middle: < 1 ... 4 5 6 ... 9 >

            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.

            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>

BoundAttributes.Name: Validation
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

            <summary>

            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: Validation
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: Validation
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

            </para>
            <para>

            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>

BoundAttributes.Name: LoadingContent
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
The content shown while Loading is true and the table has no rows. Rendered as a single table row containing one cell that spans the table width. Use this for simple messages or placeholders (for example "Loading…").
This content is displayed in addition to the table's loading animation.
For multi-row or multi-column loading layouts, use instead.

BoundAttributes.Name: LoadingContentBody
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
The content shown while Loading is true and the table has no rows. Rendered directly into the table body at the top. You must supply valid table row/cell markup (for example <MudTr> and <MudTd>). If you place plain text or non-table markup here most browsers will ignore it. Use this when you need to produce arbitrary rows and columns while the table is loading.
This content is displayed in addition to the table's loading animation.
For a single row column loading layout or text, use instead.
This value is optional, and will override if not null.

BoundAttributes.Name: LoadingContent
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
The content shown while Loading is true and the table has no rows. Rendered as a single table row containing one cell that spans the table width. Use this for simple messages or placeholders (for example "Loading…").
This content is displayed in addition to the table's loading animation.
For multi-row or multi-column loading layouts, use instead.

BoundAttributes.Name: LoadingContentBody
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
The content shown while Loading is true and the table has no rows. Rendered directly into the table body at the top. You must supply valid table row/cell markup (for example <MudTr> and <MudTd>). If you place plain text or non-table markup here most browsers will ignore it. Use this when you need to produce arbitrary rows and columns while the table is loading.
This content is displayed in addition to the table's loading animation.
For a single row column loading layout or text, use instead.
This value is optional, and will override if not null.

BoundAttributes.Documentation:
Gets the sorted and paginated data for the table. Use the provided to request items for a specific page index, page size, sort column, and sort order.
Return a which contains the requested page of items and the total number of items (excluding pagination).
Forward the to methods which support it such as HttpClient and DbContext to cancel ongoing requests.
When this parameter is set, and should not be set.

TagHelpers.Name: MudBlazor.MudTable<T>.LoadingContent
TagHelpers.Documentation:
The content shown while Loading is true and the table has no rows. Rendered as a single table row containing one cell that spans the table width. Use this for simple messages or placeholders (for example "Loading…").
This content is displayed in addition to the table's loading animation.
For multi-row or multi-column loading layouts, use instead.

TagHelpers.Name: MudBlazor.MudTable<T>.LoadingContentBody
TagHelpers.Documentation:
The content shown while Loading is true and the table has no rows. Rendered directly into the table body at the top. You must supply valid table row/cell markup (for example <MudTr> and <MudTd>). If you place plain text or non-table markup here most browsers will ignore it. Use this when you need to produce arbitrary rows and columns while the table is loading.
This content is displayed in addition to the table's loading animation.
For a single row column loading layout or text, use instead.
This value is optional, and will override if not null.

            <remarks>

            <list type="bullet"> 
            <item><description><c>{first_item}</c>: The index of the first row being displayed.</description></item> 
            <item><description><c>{last_item}</c>: The index of the last row being displayed.</description></item> 
            <item><description><c>{all_items}</c>: The total number of rows in all pages.</description></item> 
            </list> 
            </remarks>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: KeepPanelsAlive
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
Persists the content of tabs when they are not visible. Defaults to false.
When false, selecting a tab will initialize its content each time the tab is visited.
When true, a tab's content is initialized only once and is hidden via display:none.

BoundAttributes.Documentation:
Persists the content of tabs when they are not visible. Defaults to false.
When false, selecting a tab will initialize its content each time the tab is visited.
When true, a tab's content is initialized only once and is hidden via display:none.

<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

            <para>

            </para>

            </para>
            </remarks>

BoundAttributes.Name: AmPm
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
Shows a 12-hour selection clock. Defaults to false.
When true, hours 1-12 are displayed with an AM or PM marker.
When false, hours 0-23 are displayed.

BoundAttributes.Name: TimeFormat
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
The format applied to time values. Defaults to hh:mm tt when is true, otherwise HH:mm.
Format strings are typically a combination of these characters:
* h (lowercase) for hours in 12-hour time,
* H (uppercase) for hours in 24-hour time,
* m for minutes,
* tt for AM/PM markers.
For example: h:mm tt would display 6:32 PM, and HH:mm would display 18:32.

            <summary>

            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.

            </para>
            <para>

            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.

BoundAttributes.Documentation:
Shows a 12-hour selection clock. Defaults to false.
When true, hours 1-12 are displayed with an AM or PM marker.
When false, hours 0-23 are displayed.

BoundAttributes.Name: TimeFormat
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
The format applied to time values. Defaults to hh:mm tt when is true, otherwise HH:mm.
Format strings are typically a combination of these characters:
* h (lowercase) for hours in 12-hour time,
* H (uppercase) for hours in 24-hour time,
* m for minutes,
* tt for AM/PM markers.
For example: h:mm tt would display 6:32 PM, and HH:mm would display 18:32.

BoundAttributes.Name: Validation
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudFormComponent`2.Validation">
            <summary>
            The function used to detect problems with the input.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            When using a <see cref="T:MudBlazor.MudForm" />, this property can be any of several kinds of functions:
            <para>
            1. A <c>Func<T,bool></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<bool>></c> function.  Returns <c>true</c> if valid.  When <c>false</c>, a standard <c>"Invalid"</c> message is shown.
            </para>
            <para>
            2. A <c>Func<T,string></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<string>></c> function.  Returns <c>null</c> if valid, or a string explaining the error.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<T,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<T,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            3. A <c>Func<object,string,IEnumerable<string>></c> or <c>Func<object,string,Task<IEnumerable<string>>></c> function.  Given the form model and path to the member, returns an empty list if valid, or a list of validation errors.
            </para>
            <para>
            4. A <see cref="T:System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" /> object.
            </para>
            </remarks>
        </member>

<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudVirtualize`1.OverscanCount">
            <summary>
            Gets or sets a value that determines how many additional items will be rendered
            before and after the visible region. This help to reduce the frequency of rendering
            during scrolling. However, higher values mean that more elements will be present
            in the page.
            </summary>
        </member>

BoundAttributes.Name: MaxItemCount
BoundAttributes.Documentation:
<member name="P:MudBlazor.MudVirtualize`1.MaxItemCount">
             <summary>
             Gets or sets the maximum number of items that will be rendered, even if the client reports
             that its viewport is large enough to show more. The default value is 100.
            
             This should only be used as a safeguard against excessive memory usage or large data loads.
             Do not set this to a smaller number than you expect to fit on a realistic-sized window, because
             that will leave a blank gap below and the user may not be able to see the rest of the content.
             </summary>
        </member>

TagHelpers.Name: Bind
TagHelpers.Documentation: Binds the provided expression to an attribute and a change event, based on the naming of the bind attribute. For example: @bind-value="..." and @bind-value:event="onchange" will assign the current value of the expression to the 'value' attribute, and assign a delegate that attempts to set the value to the 'onchange' attribute.

BoundAttributes.Name: @bind-...
BoundAttributes.Documentation: Binds the provided expression to an attribute and a change event, based on the naming of the bind attribute. For example: @bind-value="..." and @bind-value:event="onchange" will assign the current value of the expression to the 'value' attribute, and assign a delegate that attempts to set the value to the 'onchange' attribute.

BoundAttributeParameters.Name: format
BoundAttributeParameters.Documentation: Specifies a format to convert the value specified by the corresponding bind attribute. For example: @bind-value:format="..." will apply a format string to the value specified in @bind-value="...". The format string can currently only be used with expressions of type DateTime.

BoundAttributeParameters.Name: event
BoundAttributeParameters.Documentation: Specifies the event handler name to attach for change notifications for the value provided by the '@bind-...' attribute.

BoundAttributeParameters.Name: culture
BoundAttributeParameters.Documentation: Specifies the culture to use for conversions.

BoundAttributeParameters.Name: get
BoundAttributeParameters.Documentation: Specifies the expression to use for binding the value to the attribute.

BoundAttributeParameters.Name: set
BoundAttributeParameters.Documentation: Specifies the expression to use for updating the bound value when a new value is available.

BoundAttributeParameters.Name: after
BoundAttributeParameters.Documentation: Specifies an action to run after the new value has been set.
